# A cached link whose output entry is gone must link again. If it reuses the
# binary, the linker output, here -dumpdep, never prints.

env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache

go build -ldflags=-dumpdep -o a.exe main.go
stderr '-> main\.main$'

go run drop/drop.go $GOCACHE
stdout 'dropped [1-9]'

go build -ldflags=-dumpdep -o b.exe main.go
stderr '-> main\.main$'

-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
-- drop/drop.go --
// Command drop deletes each cache output file that holds -dumpdep text.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	count := 0
	err := filepath.WalkDir(os.Args[1], func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(path, "-d") {
			return err
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if bytes.Contains(data, []byte("-> main.main\n")) {
			count++
			return os.Remove(path)
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("dropped", count)
}
